components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single green action. Used for 'Get in touch' and 'Send message'.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; background: var(--green); border: none; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease-out, transform 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--green-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. Outlined in navy; fills navy on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--navy); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--navy); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0.85rem 1.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.18s ease-out, transform 0.12s ease-out; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--navy); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with line border; navy border + soft halo on focus.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 0.5rem; } .ds-input { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 1rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 0.8rem 1rem; width: 100%; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--gold); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(74, 159, 212, 0.18); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-soft); opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Navigation Bar
components.description: Sticky bar over blurred black; logo mark + links + compact green CTA.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1.5rem; height: 4.25rem; padding: 0 1rem; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-nav-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-nav-logo { width: 2.1rem; height: 2.1rem; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--surface-raised); object-fit: contain; padding: 0.2rem; } .ds-nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-nav-link { text-decoration: none; font-family: var(--font-body); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--ink); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--gold-bright); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-game-card { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 320px 1fr; max-width: 720px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-md); overflow: hidden; } .ds-game-cover { min-height: 220px; background: var(--surface-raised); } .ds-game-art { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .ds-game-body { padding: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center; } .ds-game-tag { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-game-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.12; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink); margin: 0 0 0.5rem; } .ds-game-note { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--ink-soft); margin: 0; } .ds-game-play { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.92rem; color: var(--gold); text-decoration: none; margin-top: 0.5rem; } .ds-game-play:hover { color: var(--gold-bright); } .ds-game-live { position: absolute; top: 0.75rem; right: 0.75rem; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffffff; background: var(--green); padding: 0.3rem 0.55rem; border-radius: 999px; } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-game-card { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

narrative.overview:
AK Games' landing page is a ledger: orderly, transparent, and built for trust. Every element earns its place by answering exactly one question — does this help an investor or partner decide to engage? The palette of black ground and elevated charcoal surfaces creates a calm, authoritative reading experience. Green is saved for the single primary action; gold is reserved for links, the hero offer, and confirmed facts. The page is flat by default, with no ornament and no hero metrics. Spacing is generous, giving each section room to breathe, and the type pairing of Sora (display) and Manrope (body) strikes a balance between confident headlines and readable body text.

This is the category standard, played straight: a professional, credible, premium investor landing page that refuses both the casino-cliché trap (neon, gold motifs, playing-card imagery) and the startup-hype trap (hero metrics, big numbers, buzzwords). The craft bar is top iGaming studio level.
keyCharacteristics: Black ground (#000000) with charcoal surface (#111111) and raised step (#1c1c1c)
Flat by default; no box-shadows except the 3px focus ring
Green as the single accent for primary action only
Gold for links, the hero offer line, and confirmed facts on dark surfaces
No ornament, no gradients, no hero image, no metrics
One real game shown; placeholders are never presented as real

rules.name: The Precious Accent Rule
rules.body: Green is used for the primary action only. Gold is used for links, the hero offer, and confirmed facts. Their rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Two-Surface Rule
rules.body: The page has one black ground (#000000) and one raised surface (#111111) with a single elevation step (#1c1c1c). No further page-wide backgrounds are introduced.

rules.name: The Two-Family Rule
rules.body: Sora is reserved for display roles: headings, the hero offer, the brand, game tags, and studio fact labels. Manrope is used for everything else: body text, buttons, inputs, nav links. No mixing outside these roles.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No surface casts a shadow. Containers are distinguished by borders (1px solid var(--line)) or by switching surface elevation. The only exception is the 3px focus ring on :focus-visible and focused inputs.

dos: Do use green only for the primary action button, the Live chip, and the form success state.
Do use gold for links, the hero offer line, and confirmed facts on dark surfaces.
Do keep the body ground black (#000000) and the surface #111111 with a raised #1c1c1c step.
Do use Sora for display roles (headings, offer, brand, tags, labels) and Manrope for everything else.
Do use the 7-step spacing scale (0.5rem through 8rem) for all gaps, padding, and margins.
Do use 6px radius for interactive elements (buttons, inputs) and 12px radius for containers (cards, success box).
Do use the 3px focus ring (#4a9fd4 with 3px offset) for all interactive elements.
Do keep the page flat — no box-shadows, no gradients as decoration.
donts: Don't use green or gold on light surfaces — there are no light surfaces in this theme.
Don't introduce further background elevations beyond the two documented surfaces.
Don't use Sora for body text, buttons, or form labels.
Don't use kickers, eyebrows, or decorative labels above headings.
Don't add metrics, hero images, or big numbers to the hero viewport.
Don't use casino-cliché motifs (neon, playing cards, dice, chips) or startup-hype patterns (hero stats, testimonials, carousels).
Don't use the Live chip's pill shape (999px radius) as a general system pattern — it is a status badge, not a design token.
